new_articles.title: Hyundai Motor India's Q2 profit falls 24% as commodity costs blunt tax-cut boost to demand
new_articles.summary: Hyundai Motor 관련 기사다. 기사 제목은 'Hyundai Motor India's Q2 profit falls 24% as commodity costs blunt tax-cut boost to demand'이다. Hyundai Motor India reported a profit drop of 24% in the second quarter due to increased raw material costs. Rising commodity prices for materials like copper and steel squeezed profitability despite strong vehicle demand. The company's profit after tax for the quarter was Rs 1,196 crore, down from Rs 1,572 crore the previous year. Total revenue increased significantly to Rs 20,696 crore, marking a record quarter. Hyundai Motor India ’s profit fell about 24% in the second quarter as rising raw material prices weighed on earnings, highlighting how GST cuts that have helped keep vehicle demand resilient are yet to shield automakers from mounting commodity pressures Also Read: Hyundai Motor India to hike production capacity to 1 Hyundai said operating leverage, a healthy product mix and cost-cutting moves have helped improve its EBITDA margin sequentially, offering some relief against the commodity headwinds Also Read: Hyundai reveals ambitious plan at new Bayon launch; Creta to be part of big push as well Hyundai India's operations for the second half depends on its new product launches and sustained demand, though it will face a tougher year-on-year comparison as tax cuts had boosted vehicle sales last year Hyundai's results follow those of market leader Maruti Suzuki , which reported a smaller-than-expected quarterly profit on Tuesday, also underscoring the pressure on automakers from rising costs. 이 기사는 해당 기업과 연결된 해외 보도를 바탕으로 정리했다.

new_articles.title: AI chip giant SK hynix says quarterly operating profit soars 630%
new_articles.summary: SK hynix 관련 기사다. 기사 제목은 'AI chip giant SK hynix says quarterly operating profit soars 630%'이다. South Korean chip giant SK hynix said Wednesday its third-quarter operating profit soared 632 percent on-year, largely driven by the artificial intelligence industry's explosive demand for its advanced memory chips. The memory chip giant said it had posted record revenue and operating profit for six straight quarters since the second quarter of last year. Listen to this article in summarized format Agencies Image: SK Hynix South Korean chip giant SK hynix said Wednesday its third-quarter operating profit soared 632 percent on-year, largely driven by the artificial intelligence industry's explosive demand for its advanced memory chips "SK hynix analyzed that a virtuous cycle has taken hold in which AI-driven productivity gains and new revenue generation in areas such as software development, customer service, and search lead to greater AI adoption," the chipmaker said in a statement SK hynix is a specialist supplier of high-bandwidth memory chips to US industry behemoth Nvidia , and a pillar of South Korea's tech-led economy SK hynix announced an additional plan to return 60 trillion won to shareholders on Wednesday, following the completion of a 40 trillion-won shareholder return programme "The company's stock has fallen nearly 60 percent from its peak (in June), and I think that is the main reason the company needs to focus on winning back shareholders", Kim Dae-jong, a professor of business administration at Sejong University, told AFP. 이 기사는 해당 기업과 연결된 해외 보도를 바탕으로 정리했다.

matched_articles.summary: Hyundai Motor 관련 기사다. 기사 제목은 'Hyundai Motor India's Q2 profit falls 24% as commodity costs blunt tax-cut boost to demand'이다. Hyundai Motor India reported a profit drop of 24% in the second quarter due to increased raw material costs. Rising commodity prices for materials like copper and steel squeezed profitability despite strong vehicle demand. The company's profit after tax for the quarter was Rs 1,196 crore, down from Rs 1,572 crore the previous year. Total revenue increased significantly to Rs 20,696 crore, marking a record quarter.
